item.title: Community Cinema Course Returns to Penn State Schuylkill This Spring
item.description: Penn State Schuylkill will once again host its popular community enrichment cinema course this spring, inviting participants to take a deeper look at how comedy has evolved in film and what those changes say about modern culture and public discourse. The four-part course, titled Media, Manipulation, and the Demise of Public Discourse, will explore humor’s shifting role in cinema, including the decline of the traditional romantic comedy. item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Mahanoy Area Builds Big Lead, Holds Off Tri-Valley for Schuylkill League Division 2 Victory
item.description: Mahanoy Area used a strong opening half and a steady finish to earn a 56–44 Schuylkill League Division 2 victory over Tri-Valley on the road. item.title: Southbound Interstate 81 Closed South of Schuylkill County
item.description: Interstate 81 southbound is closed Saturday afternoon south of Schuylkill County.Around 3:15pm, Saturday, emergency personnel from Pine Grove Township were requested to shut down Interstate 81 southbound at Pine Grove Exit (Exit 100), due to a motor vehicle accident.The crash involves a jackknifed tractor trailer over the embankment on the curve at mile marker 93 in Lebanon County.Interstate 81 southbound into Lebanon County is expected to be closed for an extended period of time.
